mentions.name: ato
mentions.description: A browser extension for managing tabs that grew out of the author's recurring AI test prompt for building tab-management extensions; it replaces a duplicate-tab-killing extension that broke with Chrome's MV3 transition and is now maintained entirely through Claude Code, including its README.
mentions.problem: The extension previously used to kill duplicated tabs stopped working after a year due to the Manifest V3 (MV3) transition.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My "test prompt" for AIs used to be to create an extension to manage tabs. After a year and with MV3 the extension I used to kill duplicated tabs died.

Now this one became my favorite extension.

https://github.com/jeanlucaslima/ato
